text:
ira: deploy-bot failed to publish canary v2026.09 to staging. holding change window.
deploy-bot: ERROR finalize upload: ETAG mismatch on complete (expected="b5d3...", got="b5d2..."). upload_id=up-77aa attempts=5 :cry: 
ben: ETAG flip usually means a storage replication/write race or abort during finalize. which mirror?
ira: mirror-us-east-2 via mirror-proxy. retry loop tried 4 times and aborts.
ci-bot: failing step: `artifact.publish.finalize` job_id=4302, log excerpt attached.
infra-bot: noticed storage repointing job running for shard-7 at 2026-03-26T04:12Z; some replicas were temporarily read-only. ref: https://status.internal/storage/shard-7
tina: change window ends at 05:00Z. product (paul) - can we slip?
paul-pm: metrics tweak in this build is low-risk but we prefer not to miss the customer-facing release. product ok with promote previous if needed.
ops-oncall: I can pause repoint job and trigger metadata reconciliation for shard-7, estimate ~18m. We can then re-run finalize.
ben: if we wait and reconcile, should we also attempt a serial upload (disable multipart parallel) to avoid partial finalize conflicts?
ira: good call. deployctl flag: `--multipart-parallel=1` reduces H-O-L.
ops-oncall: plan: pause repoint, reconcile, then guarded retry with serial upload for 15m. If still failing at T+15 -> manual-promote previous digest to preserve window.
release-bot: noted window and decision point. I'll set a reminder for 15m.
deploy-bot: queued retry (upload_id=up-77aa, mode=serial, timeout=90s).
ops-oncall: update 10m: reconcile finished, retries showing mixed success, some completes still returning etag mismatch on finalize.
ben: odd - replicas show different etag for same object, suggests stale index on one replica. we should avoid promoting while index inconsistent.
tina: product signoff: promote previous to keep schedule if we can't get green in 15m.
ops-oncall: time check: 12m left. proceeding with one final retry window.
ira: drafting release-note snippet in case we promote: "Promotion to staging held due to artifact ETAG mismatch during finalize against storage shard-7. To preserve release window, previous build will be promoted; fix and follow-up hotfix planned."
ops-oncall: final update 15m: finalize still returns etag mismatch intermittently. consensus?
ben: +1 promote previous digest and create postmortem and ticket to add preflight storage-consistency check in deployctl.
paul-pm: agreed. do the promote.
ira: executing: `deployctl promote --from-digest sha256:1122aabb --to=staging --reason="artifact finalize ETAG mismatch"`
deploy-bot: manual promote accepted, audit_id=prom-3539-01. staging now at sha256:1122aabb.
release-bot: hold closed at 2026-03-26T04:55Z. I'll post update to #release-updates.
ops-oncall: follow-ups: TICKET-7782 add pre-deploy shard healthcheck + TICKET-7783 storage reconcile automation. assigning owners.
ira: tagging for PM and infra. good catch everyone.
paul-pm: will update stakeholders and schedule hotfix for the metrics tweak in next window.
